messages:
julia: dropping notes from quick design review of API Key management UI. focus: rotate vs revoke prominence, slide-over CTAs, empty state copy, show-secret a11y, mobile safe-area. figma link in thread.

mike: short q — why is Rotate the main CTA? ops expect Revoke more visible.

julia: we nudged rotate as its safer (regen vs immediate block). proposal: Rotate = filled primary, Revoke = left-aligned red text button with trash icon so its visible but less likely to be clicked by mistake.

aisha: add helper under scope chips: "Rotation preserves scopes (Admin / Read / Embed-only)"  users keep asking if scopes change.

dan: accessibility nits: 1) show-secret toggle needs aria-label and state announcements; 2) hint under key name is 12px low-contrast.

julia: proposed aria-label: "Show API secret (reveals sensitive key)". Add an aria-live polite region that announces "API secret revealed" or "API secret hidden". Increase hint to 14px and use color-strong.

mike: dev note: use aria-controls + aria-expanded on the toggle and update hidden live region text. do not shift keyboard focus when revealing.

sam: mobile: slide-over becomes full-screen on small widths. make primary action reachable above the soft keyboard and add safe-area padding. Revoke should remain visible without scrolling where possible.

aisha: revoke modal copy is weak. Suggested: "Revoking this key will immediately stop any services using it. This action cannot be undone." Buttons: Cancel (neutral), Revoke key (danger). Add link: "Run dependency scan" and footer note: "This action will be recorded in Audit logs."

dan: modal a11y: focus trap, escape closes, revoke button should have aria-describedby referencing the consequence paragraph.

julia: empty state wording debate: keep "Create your first key" for new users (analytics shows "create" is common). Subcopy: "API keys allow your services and scripts to call the Redwood API securely." Illustration should be decorative (alt=""). Heading use H2.

mike: copy-to-clipboard button aria-label = "Copy secret to clipboard". Show toast "Copied API key" with role=status and aria-live=polite, do not steal focus.

dan: toasts: polite for success, assertive for failures. make sure tooltips are keyboard accessible.

julia: rotation flow: one-time secret panel must say: "This is the new secret. You will not be able to see it again. Copy now and store it in a secrets manager. Redwood will not retain this value." Optional small link: "Download .env" next to Copy (client-side blob only).

aisha: legal ok with that phrasing. also propose optional checkbox: "Rotate and notify owners" that emails team owners; default off.

mike: backend will return secret once; client handles display/copy/download. avoid logging the value.

dan: small UI nit: change copy icon tooltip from "Copy" to "Copy secret" and set aria-pressed briefly during copy for assistive feedback.

sam: keyboard shortcut idea: within keys page, allow `c` to open create modal. show tiny hint in header: "Press c to create". ensure shortcut scoped to page.

julia: action items: julia update figma copy and slide-over, mike implement aria-live + toasts and mobile safe-area, dan run a11y pass and keyboard checks, sam test mobile and shortcuts, aisha finalize copy with legal. will paste final strings here after figma update. thanks :sparkles:
